messages:
Ana: Quick sync — we need a final cutlist to keep the MVP date. I have a trimmed proposal.
Devon: please paste options.
Ana: Proposal: ship runtime + core API + minimal model-pinning (model_id only via API + CLI) + tiny console header showing pinned model. Defer full pin UI, advanced tag filters, long-route telemetry retention, embeddings dashboard, and automated evals to v1.
Priya: Agree. Full pin UI is at least 2 FE sprints. Backend RPC is ready.
Kai: Pilots prioritized rollback and predictable latency over dashboards. Can we guarantee rollback without UI?
Devon: Yes — implement POST /v1/pins/rollback and a small CLI wrapper. Add audit logs with request_id and actor. Estimate: rollback endpoint + logs = 4 dev-days; CLI + docs = 6 dev-days; header + toggle = 4 dev-days.
Raj: I'll ping pilots now: @acme_pilot and @greenleaf_pilot. Both asked for visibility but said dashboards are "nice-to-have."
Marie: UX: header must state "pinned models are global to tenant" and link to CLI instructions. I'll draft copy and onboarding checklist.
Ana: Keep canary core and a minimal console toggle + % slider; advanced rollout flows to v1.
Kai: I'll run a quick safety runbook to validate rollback <3m and canary fallback adds <500ms latency. Will report back tomorrow.
Devon: Also propose a short-term mitigation: expose metrics via /metrics + Grafana dashboard template for pilots who want dashboards now. Low effort.
Priya: Good idea — gives pilots data without full product work.
release-bot: Reminder — milestone freeze in 6 business days. last build cutoff: 4177775400.
Ana: Action items: Devon confirm dev estimates by EOD; Kai run SLA validation; Marie write header & CLI docs; Raj get pilot sign-off. I'll update the milestone tracker and mark UI items as v1 backlog.
Raj: Pinged pilots — waiting for thumbs up.
Marie: Drafted header copy: "Pinned models are global to your tenant. Use CLI or API to change. Changes are audited."
Devon: Noted — I'll log audit trail and wire the rollback endpoint.
Ana: If pilots push back we'll re-evaluate, but aim to lock scope by EOD tomorrow. Thanks team.
